Credit Policy — Home Loan & LAP Underwriting Manual

1. Loan-to-Value (LTV) Limits

For home loans up to INR 30 Lakhs, maximum LTV ratio is 90%. For loans between INR 30 Lakhs and 75 Lakhs, maximum LTV is 80%. For loans above 75 Lakhs, maximum LTV is 75%.

2. Fixed Obligation to Income Ratio (FOIR)

Maximum allowable FOIR including proposed housing EMI is capped at 55% for salaried applicants and 60% for self-employed professionals.

3. Title Legal Clearance

Mandatory 30-year search report from bank-empanelled advocate and technical valuation report by two independent valuers for property value exceeding INR 1 Crore.
